text:
[LSCP.2.1.1] The schema's facts are asserted by `emit` and
retracted by `withdraw` actions in rule RHSs. The engine does
not auto-manage the lifetime.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_shape
idris.note: A successful withdraw removed exactly the fact and changed no other kind.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__spend_rule
idris.note: `Seed s -> withdraw s`: the explicit input a derivation rested on, withdrawn.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__all_explicit
idris.note: Every kind explicit: the lifecycle map of the withdraw witnesses.

idris.name: Lgra_10_1__action
idris.note: The clause's two actions on an explicit schema's facts: `emit` asserts, `withdraw` removes a bound fact. Explicit is the only lifecycle withdraw may target.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_fact
idris.note: Remove exactly the bound fact; a no-op if it is already gone. The engine does not auto-manage the lifetime: nothing else removes an explicit fact.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw
idris.note: Withdraw a bound fact; a no-op when it is already gone.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_unique
idris.note: Withdraw keeps one live fact per key: a retraction, or nothing.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__any_same_elem
idris.note: A fact some live fact equals is live.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_view
idris.note: WITHDRAW keeps the view: a retraction of a live fact, or nothing.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_ordered
idris.note: WITHDRAW keeps the order: a retraction of a live fact, or nothing.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_g
idris.note: Withdraw with the set beside it.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_sound
idris.note: WITHDRAW keeps the ghost sound: a retraction of a live fact, or nothing.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_fact_shape
idris.note: A withdraw that changes working memory removes a live fact of the same identity: the withdraw action's effect.
